note: The interaction verbs (GROUND_SYSTEMS.md §5): what the E key can do to a world thing. Append only: an entry's index is its number on the wire (InteractIntent.Verb). Each verb is offered and done by exactly one capability's handler (capabilities.json, Hollow.Simulation's Capabilities/), checked at start. label: what the prompt and the radial say before the thing's name; named: false leaves the name out of the prompt (SET CODE, OPEN TECH TREE); glyph: the radial's outline by name (RadialGlyphs); description: the radial's line under the title; priority: the order of the ring, and which of the options their handlers mark primary a tap of E does (the highest); reach: which of survival.json's reaches it needs (interact by default), to the thing's nearest surface; sight: whether the eye must see that surface (yes by default); code: a four-digit code is asked first (the keypad); panel: it opens a panel of the interface rather than asking the server (the tech tree); menu: false keeps it out of the radial (a panel's own button sends it); switch: on or off, a device's switch (the loot panel's button finds it by this); alive, awake: the doer must be (yes by default); wounded, seated: whether the wounded, or one in a seat, may (no by default).
